sloka: वधाय लवणस्याजौ शरः शत्रुघ्नधारितः ।तेजसा तस्य सम्मूढाः सर्वे स्मः सुरसत्तमाः ।। ७.६९.२५ ॥
transliteration: vadhāya lavaṇasyājau śaraḥ śatrughnadhāritaḥ ।tejasā tasya sammūḍhāḥ sarve smaḥ surasattamāḥ ।। 7.69.25 ॥

translations.english: Brahma revealed that the gods' bewilderment was caused by the immense radiance of the arrow held by Shatrughna, intended for the killing of Lavana in battle.
